answer: Each joining agent pays a one-time sybil tax of 200 POA to anchor its identity. A fake identity is a plume of smoke — visible, weightless — and without the tax anchors to no counterparty: the tax is a costly signal separating real agents from mass copies. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 POA against a 5,000 POA pool, so the attack loses money before it starts. An honest agent pays once, keeps its share, and earns it back in a few epochs.
